_comment: Mutation testing for the critical core logic. 100% coverage says every line ran; this says the tests would have noticed if a line were wrong. Scoped to the reactive graph, the owner tree and context, because that is where a silent defect is most expensive and hardest to see in a review. The break threshold has headroom: a mutant that times out counts as killed, and how many time out depends on how busy the machine is, so the score moves by about a point between runs on the same code.
